d: Fabric is cloth or material that is used for making clothes or covering furniture.
Your face is the front part of your head where your eyes, nose, and mouth are located.
A facility is a building or piece of equipment designed for a specific purpose, like a hospital or gym.
A fact is a piece of information that is known to be completely true.
A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.
A factory is a large building where goods are produced using machines.
If something fades, it slowly becomes lighter in color or less clear to see and hear.
If you fail a test or a task, you do not succeed in doing it.
Failure is the disappointing situation when you do not succeed in achieving your goal.
If you faint, you suddenly lose consciousness and fall to the ground.
If a situation is fair, it is reasonable, right, and treats everyone equally.
You use fairly to say that something happens to a moderate or reasonable degree.
Faith is a strong belief and complete trust in someone or something.
If something is fake, it is not real but is made to look like something real to trick people.
If you fall, you suddenly drop down to the ground.
If a statement is false, it is completely incorrect and not true.
If someone is familiar, you recognize them because you have seen them before.
A family is a group of people who are related to each other, like parents and children.
If someone is famous, they are known and recognized by a lot of people around the world.
A fan is a person who enthusiastically supports a specific sports team, musician, or actor.
If something is fancy, it is highly decorative, expensive, and not plain.
If you say something is fantastic, you mean it is extremely good or wonderful.
If a place is far, it is a long distance away from where you are.
A farm is a large area of land used for growing crops and keeping animals.
A farmer is a person who owns or manages a farm.
Fashion is the popular style of clothing, hair, or behavior at a particular time.
If someone or something is fast, they move or happen at a very high speed.
If a person or animal is fat, they have a lot of extra flesh on their body.
A father is a male parent of a child.
If a bad situation is your fault, you are the one responsible for causing it.
A favor is a kind and helpful action that you do for someone else.
Your favorite thing is the one that you like the most out of all the others.
Fear is the strong feeling of worry you get when you think you are in danger.
A feature is an interesting or important part, quality, or characteristic of something.
A fee is an amount of money you pay to a professional person for their work.
If you feed a person or an animal, you give them food to eat.
When you feel an emotion, you experience that specific physical or mental state.
A feeling is an emotion such as happiness, anger, or sadness that you experience.
You use fellow to describe people who are in the same situation or group as you.
Female means belonging to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.
A fence is a wooden or metal structure built around a piece of land to keep people or animals in or out.
A festival is a special day or period when people celebrate something, often with music and food.
A fever is a medical condition where your body temperature is dangerously higher than normal.
You use few to indicate that there is only a very small number of something.
Fiction refers to books and stories about imaginary people and events, rather than real facts.
A field is a large open area of land covered in grass, often used for farming or playing sports.
If a person or animal is fierce, they are violently aggressive and frightening.
When people fight, they use physical force to try to hurt or defeat each other.
A figure is an official number, amount, or statistic.
A file is a folder or box used for keeping documents organized and safe.
If you fill a container, you put so much into it that there is no space left.
A film is a series of moving pictures telling a story, usually shown in a cinema or on television.
The final thing in a series is the very last one.
You use finally to state that something happens after a very long wait.
Finance is the management and organization of large amounts of money by a company or government.
Financial means relating to money or how money is managed.
If you find something, you discover where it is after searching for it.
If you feel fine, you feel healthy, happy, and completely okay.
Your fingers are the five long parts attached to the end of your hand.
When you finish doing something, you reach the end of it and complete it.
Fire is the hot, bright flames produced by things that are burning.
A firm is a professional business or company, such as a law firm.
The first thing is the one that happens or comes before all the others.
A fish is a cold-blooded animal that lives in water and breathes through gills.
If clothes fit you, they are the exact right size and shape for your body.
If you fix something that is broken, you repair it so that it works again.
A flag is a piece of cloth with a special pattern used as the symbol of a country.
A flame is a hot, bright stream of burning gas coming from a fire.
If a light flashes, it shines very brightly for a fraction of a second.
If a surface is flat, it is completely smooth and level, with no bumps or curves.
The flavor of food or drink is the specific taste it has in your mouth.
Flesh is the soft substance between the skin and bones of animal or human bodies.
A flight is a journey made through the air in an airplane or helicopter.
If an object floats, it stays on the surface of a liquid without sinking.
A flood is a dangerous situation where a large amount of water covers dry land.
The floor is the flat surface that you walk on inside a room.
Flour is a white powder made from crushed wheat, used to bake bread and cakes.
If a liquid flows, it moves steadily and continuously in one direction.
A flower is the colorful part of a plant that produces seeds.
When a bird or plane flies, it moves smoothly through the air.
If you focus on something, you pay all your attention to it and ignore distractions.
When you fold paper or cloth, you bend it so that one part covers another.
Folk is an informal word used to refer to people in general.
If you follow someone, you walk or drive closely behind them.
Food is the solid things that people and animals eat to survive.
Your foot is the part of your body at the end of your leg that you stand on.
Football is a popular game played by two teams trying to kick a ball into a goal.
Force is extreme physical power or strength used to move or break something.
If something is foreign, it comes from a country that is not your own.
A forest is a very large area of land covered thickly with trees and plants.
If something lasts forever, it continues for all time without ever ending.
If you forget something, you are unable to remember it.
If you forgive someone, you stop being angry at them for something bad they did.
A fork is a tool with a handle and metal points used for picking up food.
A form is an official document with empty spaces where you write your information.
Formal clothes or events are very serious, polite, and suitable for official occasions.
If you move forward, you move in the direction that you are facing.
A fragment is a small piece or broken part of something larger.
If something fragments, it breaks violently into many small, separate pieces.
If something is frequent, it happens very often and repeatedly.
If you frequent a place, you visit it regularly and spend a lot of time there.
